pin.estimand: The least-favourable maximum, across cl100k_base and o200k_base, of the equal-force balanced mean token_delta on sixteen wholly fresh complete pairs: eight may-as-permission versus is permitted to and eight may-as-possibility versus might. Replication of ead8571c… with different inputs.
admissibility_gates: all sixteen complete pairs are unique, affirmative, and published at origin/main before minting
no pair string is shared with the original measurement's test_set
tokenizer work happens only after the server confirms the stored manifest

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
row.settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

manifest.method: For each pinned tokenizer, count len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)) without special tokens. Average equally within each eight-item force stratum, then average the two force means equally. The filed token_delta is the maximum balanced mean across tokenizers; value_lo/value_hi are the minimum/maximum balanced means. Report each force separately under every tokenizer.
manifest.population: sixteen short affirmative operational modal statements: eight authority-permission claims and eight speaker-evidence possibility claims
manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.selection: Eight wholly fresh complete meaning-matched pairs per force, frozen and published before tokenizer load; equal-weight strata; no negated may; no pair string shared with the original ead8571c…
